title: Validity of the search-machine precondition
statement: For every Boolean string $x$ and every abstract configuration of the search machine with parameter $K_0$, the machine’s precondition holds: any register comparison uses distinct registers, and any oracle call uses a list of pairwise distinct registers.
replaced:
For every bit string $x$ and every configuration of the deterministic part of the search
machine with parameter $K_0$, the precondition defining admissible comparisons, input
comparisons, and oracle calls holds.
